rows.grounds: locative indicating the eastern direction for placement or invocation
compound naming the goddess Agnimahādurgā as the object established or invoked
genitive plural specifying the domain over which presiding authority is held

items.question: Which deity is designated the presiding power of the mantras in the eastern direction?
premises: The eastern direction is specified as the locus of the rite.
Agnimahādurgā is named as the deity to be established there.
This deity holds presiding authority over the mantras.
items.inference: Agnimahādurgā is to be established in the east as the presiding deity of the mantras.
uncertainties: The governing verb is supplied from the preceding ritual context of establishing and kindling the fire.
items.plain_english: In the east, one should establish Agnimahādurgā as the presiding deity of the mantras.
